Name: Happy Hay
Author: FawazT
Description:
[b][size=4]What it does[/size][/b]
In vanilla, an animal that eats hay from the trough gets less out of the meal than one that eats grass outside. Happy Hay lets animals in your barns and coops eat through the same logic the game uses for grass, so both meals award the same mood and friendship.

With the optional chance enabled, a hay meal can instead award what blue grass gives: [b]+16 friendship instead of +8[/b]. The roll happens once per animal per day, seeded from the animal and the date, so reloading a save cannot reroll it, and the total is still capped at 1000 friendship like vanilla.

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hay meals give the same mood and friendship as eating grass outside.[/*]
[*]Optional chance for a hay meal to award the blue grass friendship bonus (+16 instead of +8).[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download the mod and extract it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
3. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings in-game.

[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
The mod adds a [b]Double friendship chance[/b] slider to Generic Mod Config Menu, from 0% to 100%:

You can also edit [b]Mods/HappyHay/config.json[/b] directly:
[code]{
  "DoubleFriendshipChancePercent": 0
}[/code][line]

[size=4][b]When it applies[/b][/size]
Only where vanilla would grant a hay meal: an animal in a barn or coop, with hay in the trough, on a day when the animal is actually hungry. Rainy days, winter, and animals that are already full are left untouched.
